en: Exodus 38

p.src: 1  He made the altar of burnt offering of acacia wood. It was square. Its length was five cubits, its width was five cubits, and its height was three cubits.

en: He made the altar of burnt offering of acacia wood. It was square. Its length was five cubits, its width was five cubits, and its height was three cubits.
u.src: 1  He made the altar of burnt offering of acacia wood. It was square. Its length was five cubits, its width was five cubits, and its height was three cubits.

en: 38:1 A cubit is the length from the tip of the middle finger to the elbow on a man’s arm, or about 18 inches or 46 centimeters.

p.src: 2  He made its horns on its four corners. Its horns were of one piece with it, and he overlaid it with bronze.

en: He made its horns on its four corners. Its horns were of one piece with it, and he overlaid it with bronze.

p.src: 3  He made all the vessels of the altar: the pots, the shovels, the basins, the forks, and the fire pans. He made all its vessels of bronze.

u.src: 3  He made all the vessels of the altar: the pots, the shovels, the basins, the forks, and the fire pans. He made all its vessels of bronze.

p.src: 4  He made for the altar a grating of a network of bronze, under the ledge around it beneath, reaching halfway up.

en: He made for the altar a grating of a network of bronze, under the ledge around it beneath, reaching halfway up.
u.src: 4  He made for the altar a grating of a network of bronze, under the ledge around it beneath, reaching halfway up.

p.src: 5  He cast four rings for the four corners of bronze grating, to be places for the poles.

p.src: 6  He made the poles of acacia wood, and overlaid them with bronze.

u.src: 6  He made the poles of acacia wood, and overlaid them with bronze.

p.src: 7  He put the poles into the rings on the sides of the altar, with which to carry it. He made it hollow with planks.
